title: Biofuel is Biofuel!
description: Lets you use Oritech Biofuel in Create C&A Blaze Burners!
body:
!!!REQUIRES THE FOLLOWING (NO EXCEPTIONS)!!!

Create Crafts & Additions,

Oritech,

NeoForge for Minecraft 1.21.1 (because of tag weirdness)

!!!DO NOT ask me for support if you haven't read the description!!!

Thanks!

Allows Oritech fuels (oil, biofuel, and turbofuel) to be burned in a Create Crafts & Additions "Blaze Burner with Straw".

Oil and Biofuel superheat for 5 minutes per bucket.
Turbofuel superheats for 20 min/b.


Also adds a basic shapeless recipe to convert Oritech biomass into Create Crafts & Additions biomass and back.



Contact me on Discord if you have trouble at "4x31theProtogen" (without quotes).
First Modrinth Project lets goooooo!
(title is definitely not a Mr. Incredible joke.)
